evidence.summary: 记录DSH工具变更并在差异面板审阅、保留或回退，也可导入本地版本控制改动。
limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、package.json、src/index.ts、src/pending.ts、src/persist.ts；成功工具结果折叠为路径级待审条目，用户决定经请求者文件策略写回；持久存储当前为全局pending.json。见 [Q02](#research-q02)。
limitations: 检查固定宿主结果捕获、路径合并、回退/Undo、策略写回及持久化；未逐项覆盖所有客户端渲染/VCS适配、并发或真实宿主。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 适用于希望在会话中逐块审阅Agent改动的开发者，属于事后决定而非写入前批准。对照和验收见 [Q01](#research-q01)。
成功工具结果折叠为路径级待审条目，用户决定经请求者文件策略写回；持久存储当前为全局pending.json。见 [Q02](#research-q02)。
检查固定宿主结果捕获、路径合并、回退/Undo、策略写回及持久化；未逐项覆盖所有客户端渲染/VCS适配、并发或真实宿主。
固定package确认npm身份和bundle/web入口；发布包与兼容测试声明未独立验收。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 本地待审存储与客户端 | 备份工作树、核策略/基线 | 配置时间未知 |
| 持续使用 | 前后全文存储、diff/高亮 | 逐块语义判断与测试 | 大文件资源与净节时未测 |
| 失败恢复 | 回退/重试资源与备份 | 冻结外写，核部分完成内容 | 删除不可Undo，栈不跨重启 |
| 迁移退出 | pending.json与代码备份 | 核清未决条目再禁用 | 非版本控制备份替代品 |
建议单人可备份工作树先试用，回退前冻结外写并核实际文件，保持测试/VCS验收。范围和停止条件见 [Q05](#research-q05)。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 变更汇集 | 指定工具成功结果与路径合并 | 所有shell/外部改动覆盖 |
| 策略一致 | 请求者sandbox写回 | 任意宿主策略实际执行 |
| 恢复 | 有条件Undo与持久待审 | 全回退竞态和重启后撤销 |
结构化捕获与请求者权限值得复用，统一路径身份和谱系可见性则需要严密状态管理；Undo前提可作为更普遍回退契约的参考。见 [Q05](#research-q05)。
把工具变更基线、细粒度审阅和会话讨论纳入同一流程，相对手工打开VCS减少切换；不替代权限审批或测试。见 [Q01](#research-q01)。
Undo内容检查不等于所有回退都有并发保护，栈不跨重启且新增文件删除不可Undo；回退前需核实际内容。见 [Q03](#research-q03)。
未验证假设为给所有回退增加展示内容摘要与后端原子比较前提，以减少外写竞态；临时文件对照与否定边界见 [Q05](#research-q05)。

technical.rationale: novelty 50%档，相对普通diff集成工具结果基线与会话谱系，非新diff算法；mechanism 50%档，请求者政策和有条件Undo改善恢复取舍，整体并发未保证；transferability 50%档，结构化捕获可复用但依赖宿主结果契约；simplification 50%档，审阅与会话合并减少切换，多状态恢复增加实现负担。

business.rationale: workflow 50%档，将审阅决定放回Agent协作流程，非预写批准；delivery 50%档，提供持久未决变更与讨论交接，正确性需测试；reach 25%档，降低命令行diff门槛但业务判断仍必需；economics 25%档，可能减少切换，实际漏审/时间/资源收益未知。

recommendation.reason: 有独立备份且能暂停其他写入者的开发者可试用会话内逐块审阅和回退Agent变更。相比切换编辑器查差异，源码支持把工具产生的变更及审阅决定集中到面板，净效率未测。若面板与磁盘不一致、存在外部写入或需要删除新建文件而无备份，应停止回退并改用Git及编辑器核查。

scenario.rationale: 依据[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)，README第29—48行给出逐块决定和评论场景，src/index.ts第2484—2496行捕获工具结果。经常由Agent修改多文件的个人开发者需要把变更与会话决定关联，反复切编辑器并追踪待审项的摩擦具体，支持23分超过15分。目标必须是写后审阅而非写前授权；偶发小修改已有Git diff足够，当前没有采用频率、审阅错误下降或持续必要性的直接用户材料，不足30分，项目名称approval不能扩张任务保障。

advantage.rationale: 依据[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)，src/pending.ts第109—131行聚合同路径变更，index.ts第2351—2375行对Undo做预期内容核查，面板能管理逐块决定与跨会话待办，相比只看Git diff是实质交互增量，取19分高于13分。原生编辑器也有差异审阅，插件并非独有；整文件回退缺少同样新鲜度门，新建删除不可Undo，所以不能以所有回退可撤销支撑25分。未测总审阅时间和错误率，只确认流程差异。

evidence.rationale: 依据[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)，实际核查src/index.ts第2057—2075行和2351—2375行，确认回退会直接写oldText且删除不入撤销栈，Undo才检查expectedFile；persist.ts第1—15行为全局pending存储。主链路、持久化和关键反证均有固定源码，可支持受控工作树试用，取13分而非只看入口的6分。README部分隔离与可撤销说法不作为保障，源码已明确收窄解释；未执行真实文件交错写入或重启恢复，不能取19分，更不能当宿主验收。

cost.rationale: 依据[Q03](#research-q03)、[Q04](#research-q04)，src/index.ts第2063—2065行回退前读现文但不比较展示基线，第2072—2075行明确Undo仅内存且删除不压栈，src/persist.ts第2—8行保存前后全文。用户必须额外备份、暂停编辑器和构建器、核对磁盘与面板，重启和删除恢复缺口仍重要，因此取5分而非可行退路较完整的10分。隔离副本和Git备份能限制损失，未达到目标条件下必然不可接受的0分；但不能因UI便利把这些恢复责任隐藏。

| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 变更捕获 | 汇集edit/write/editor成功改动 | 不是所有外部变更 |
| 差异决定 | 整文件/块级保留或回退 | 已写入后的事后审阅 |

# dsh-diff-approval > 记录DSH工具变更并在差异面板审阅、保留或回退，也可导入本地版本控制改动。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[9087/dsh-diff-approval](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval) - **版本号**：0.36.1（[固定提交 c52399da9e58cd46ab7403ce785d4f04579f0b71](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval/tree/c52399da9e58cd46ab7403ce785d4f04579f0b71)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-26（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 捕获/合并/政策写回有源码支持；全回退竞态、实际恢复与性能未运行验证；原子内容前提是假设。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：适用于希望在会话中逐块审阅Agent改动的开发者，属于事后决定而非写入前批准。对照和验收见 [Q01](#research-q01)。 - **亮点**：把工具变更基线、细粒度审阅和会话讨论纳入同一流程，相对手工打开VCS减少切换；不替代权限审批或测试。见 [Q01](#research-q01)。 - **思考**：Undo内容检查不等于所有回退都有并发保护，栈不跨重启且新增文件删除不可Undo；回退前需核实际内容。见 [Q03](#research-q03)。 - **建议**：未验证假设为给所有回退增加展示内容摘要与后端原子比较前提，以减少外写竞态；临时文件对照与否定边界见 [Q05](#research-q05)。 采用建议：建议单人可备份工作树先试用，回退前冻结外写并核实际文件，保持测试/VCS验收。范围和停止条件见 [Q05](#research-q05)。 ## 核心贡献 把工具变更基线、细粒度审阅和会话讨论纳入同一流程，相对手工打开VCS减少切换；不替代权限审批或测试。见 [Q01](#research-q01)。 ## 关键质疑 Undo内容检查不等于所有回退都有并发保护，栈不跨重启且新增文件删除不可Undo；回退前需核实际内容。见 [Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 未验证假设为给所有回退增加展示内容摘要与后端原子比较前提，以减少外写竞态；临时文件对照与否定边界见 [Q05](#research-q05)。 已检查源码，未运行目标代码、浏览器/VCS测试或真实宿主验收。 ## 场景与替代办法 适用于希望在会话中逐块审阅Agent改动的开发者，属于事后决定而非写入前批准。对照和验收见 [Q01](#research-q01)。 原生编辑器/VCS差异审阅；未以作者CI或功能数量推断正确性/速度，不将approval解释为预写门控。 ## 依赖与流程 #### 启动与依赖 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | |---|---|---|---| | 兼容DSH fs/workspace/连接服务 | 必需 | 捕获、RPC和写回 | 不保证功能可用 | | 可写待审存储 | 持久化必需 | 重启保留条目 | 错误需排查，Undo仍内存 | | Git/SVN/Perforce CLI | 对应导入必需 | 读取本地变更 | 导入失败 | | 工作树备份与人工测试 | 真实采用必需 | 恢复及语义验收 | Keep不等正确 | #### 启动步骤 | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | |---|---|---| | 1 | 用户备份临时工作树后安装重启 | 面板可见 | | 2 | 制造创建/编辑/外改并核差异 | 基线对应实际内容 | | 3 | 冻结外写，逐项Keep/Revert/Undo | 检查文件字节和删除例外 | | 4 | 重启核pending并运行测试 | 不把待审持久化当Undo持久化 | ## 成本与效果 #### 成本 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | |---|---|---|---| | 首次使用 | 本地待审存储与客户端 | 备份工作树、核策略/基线 | 配置时间未知 | | 持续使用 | 前后全文存储、diff/高亮 | 逐块语义判断与测试 | 大文件资源与净节时未测 | | 失败恢复 | 回退/重试资源与备份 | 冻结外写，核部分完成内容 | 删除不可Undo，栈不跨重启 | | 迁移退出 | pending.json与代码备份 | 核清未决条目再禁用 | 非版本控制备份替代品 | #### 效果 | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | |---|---|---| | 变更汇集 | 指定工具成功结果与路径合并 | 所有shell/外部改动覆盖 | | 策略一致 | 请求者sandbox写回 | 任意宿主策略实际执行 | | 恢复 | 有条件Undo与持久待审 | 全回退竞态和重启后撤销 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：核对事后待审变更的捕获、基线、回退与持久恢复边界。 ### Q01 · 待审变更面板相对Git diff解决什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 目标是与Agent共同编辑、希望在会话中逐块决定保留/回退的开发者。合格结果是审阅对象和实际文件一致、用户决定只作用于明确范围、回退后内容可核对。相对命令行Git diff或编辑器审阅，贡献是自动捕捉指定工具结果、跨会话待办状态、细粒度决定及评论的集成；VCS导入补充宿主工具外改动。它是修改后的审阅，不是写入前批准，文件在工具成功时已被改动，不能因名字approval而当成预防性授权闸门。已有编辑器差异工具仍是直接替代。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:11-11](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval/blob/c52399da9e58cd46ab7403ce785d4f04579f0b71/README.md#L11-L11) 作者明确successful mutations之后进入pending。 ```text A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for pending-change review: it automatically tracks every successful `edit`, `write`, and editor (`str_replace_editor`) mutation, folds them into a single pending list in the sidebar where each file's diff can be reviewed and kept/reverted — and it can also import the workspace's version-control repository's local changes (Git / SVN / Perforce) in one click. ``` **依据 2 · 作者声明**：[README.md:29-48](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval/blob/c52399da9e58cd46ab7403ce785d4f04579f0b71/README.md#L29-L48) 作者列细粒度决定、撤销、VCS和持久化。
查看原文（20行） ```text - **Diff view**: syntax-highlighted whole-file diff with +/− counts, an overview ruler on the scrollbar showing where changes sit, and an in-file search (`Ctrl+F`, step with `F3` / `Shift+F3`) that highlights matched words. Rows are virtualized, so huge files stay smooth. The line-number column keeps a surface of its own — a shade lighter than the code block, so the numbers read as a column rather than as part of the code — and stays pinned while the code scrolls sideways. - **Block navigation & decisions**: jump between change blocks with `Ctrl+↑/↓` (or the previous/next buttons) — the focused block flashes, navigation is anchored to the scroll position and wraps at the top/bottom. Hover a block to **Keep** or **Revert** just that block from a small actions frame that also shows its position (e.g. "2/5"); after a single-block decision, focus advances to the next block. The lead rows left above the jumped-to block are configurable in settings. - **Selection frame**: drag to select a range of lines and a frame appears to **Keep** / **Revert** exactly that range. - **Per-file and bulk decisions**: the files in the file list can be kept / reverted one at a time, or **Keep all** / **Revert all** from its footer. - **Resolved files stay listed**: once every change in a file has been kept/reverted, the entry remains in the list and the panel asks whether to remove it or keep it there. - **Undo / Redo**: every keep, revert, import, and comment is undoable with `Ctrl+Z` / `Ctrl+Shift+Z` (rebindable in Shortcuts; `Ctrl+Y` remains an alias), active while the panel is open — text inputs keep their own editing. - **Quick summon & file cycling**: `Ctrl+D` (configurable in settings) toggles the review panel from anywhere and `Esc` closes it; the panel is also one click away from the sidebar-foot row and from a button in the Session header beside the app's own controls; `Ctrl+Tab` / `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` cycle through the pending files. - **Line references**: select text in the diff — the status bar shows its `(file:line)` / `(file:start-end)` reference; click it (or press `Ctrl+L`) to copy, and with the setting on it auto-pastes into the composer and focuses it. References in the composer and queued messages are **auto-aligned** when the referenced file changes: surviving lines re-map to their new range, and a fully-removed line becomes `(file:LINE_MISSING)`. - **Highlight language**: auto-detected from the file extension, or overridden from a dropdown. - **Auto-wrap**: a "Wrap lines" toggle beside the language selector wraps long lines for that language (CJK breaks between characters, Latin words stay whole), remembered per language. - **Side-by-side split view**: an opt-in two-column diff (left "before" | right "current"), line-aligned with per-side horizontal scrolling and a shared vertical scrollbar. Toggle it from the toolbar or in settings (default: single-column unified view). In split view, changed blocks are aligned by content similarity and changed lines show intra-line word diffs — whole words for Latin text, per-character for CJK. - **Markdown preview**: for Markdown files, toggle between the source-line diff and a rendered before/after preview (`Preview` / `Source`); the preview content max width is configurable. With "Structure-rendered Markdown diff" in the "Diff view" group on, the diff is mapped onto the document's own Markdown rendering — lists, tables and code blocks keep their structure — and even a change the rendering cannot show is marked. The switch is off by default; while it is off the preview keeps the original fragment renderer. - **Customizable appearance**: from the "Diff view" settings group, adjust the diff's code font size (%), line height (px), the added / removed line colors, and the tab width (2 / 4 / 8 spaces), with a live preview. - **Comments & annotations**: select any lines and write a comment. The card is anchored below the selected lines and holds the discussion with the agent. Comment mode is on by default and can be turned off in settings. The agent can comment on its own (annotate): asking it to annotate a piece of code is one way to read that code faster. Say "annotate this project's startup flow for me" and it marks the entry point, the initialisation order and the important branches, line by line, to be read in order. In the side-by-side view the comment quotes both sides of the change, the removed lines and the added ones, so the agent reads the whole replacement. - **File menu**: on by default (the "File menu" row in the "Diff view" group turns it off). It takes over the click on some file links: a file row in the shell's edited / produced lists, an `@file` reference or file link in a message, and a relative link in this plugin's Markdown preview, and offers: **Open as usual** (the shell's own behaviour, replayed), **View in the review panel**, and **Copy file path**. - **Bundled CJK code font**: the panel ships JetBrains Maple Mono, subset and sliced by `unicode-range`; it is on by default and can be turned off in settings. - **External changes**: files already in the pending list are monitored — if one is later modified outside the reviewed edits (another tool, an editor), the panel adopts the new content and flags the divergence. - **Open / Reveal**: while reviewing a file's diff, open it in its default app or reveal it in the system file manager with one click. - **Import version-control changes**: when the list is empty, click the button to import the workspace's local changes from **Git / SVN / Perforce** — everything that is **not committed yet, staged or not** (Git is read against the last commit, the `git diff HEAD` view), plus deleted files and, opt-in, files the VCS has never seen (untracked / unversioned). The VCS root is found by walking up from the workspace, so a workspace inside a subdirectory works too. - **Persistence**: pending state is stored per workspace at `/diff-approval/workspaces/.json` and survives restarts — unhandled changes are still there when you come back, even in a fresh session. ```
